items.title: TCS Q4 net profit jumps 12% to Rs 13,718 crore on strong deal wins, weak rupee
items.description: TCS reported a 12% net profit rise to ₹13,718 crore in Q4, exceeding expectations despite a 2.4% annual revenue decline in constant currency terms for FY26. The company saw strong AI revenue growth, crossing $2.3 billion, and secured significant deal wins, signaling a potential turnaround amidst cautious optimism.
